**🎮 Mod Introduction**

This mod is designed to facilitate convenient management for GMs. All GM permissions in this mod are granted to OP (Operator) players, except for the Magic Wand, which requires whitelisting.

**😋 Mod Features**

**Adventure Mode:**

- In Adventure Mode, players can no longer break paintings or item frames (they can still interact with them).
- Players cannot interact with flower pots.
- Players can take books off lecterns.

**Creative Mode:**

- After renaming Lime Dye to "Locker" (上锁器), you can lock wooden doors and wooden trapdoors, preventing other players from opening them.
- Pressing 'I' in Creative Mode activates invisibility, making you and your actions invisible to other players.

**Other Features:**

- This mod requires **Simple Voice Chat** to be installed. GMs can press 'B' to broadcast their voice server-wide. This broadcast ignores mute toggles, group restrictions, and distance.
- A new mob that attacks players has been added.
  - `/projectgmb patrol record <name>` starts recording a patrol route (press Shift at the points you want the patroller to pass through).
  - `/projectgmb patrol record` stops the recording and spawns the patroller.
  - `/projectgmb patrol list` opens the patroller management interface.
  - Place the skins you want to change for the patroller in `config\projectgm_b\skins`.

**New Items:**

- **Combination Lock / Key Lock:** Shift + Right-click on any container to lock it. The combination lock requires you to enter a password when locking; the key lock requires you to select a key from your inventory when locking. Shift + Right-click a locked container to edit or remove the lock. The floating lock icon is only visible in Creative Mode.
- **Key:** This item has no actual function; it simply provides an item whose texture can be changed in-game. Place a square image (8-128 pixels) in `config\projectgm_b\keys`, then run `/projectgmb reload`. Right-click while holding the key you want to change the skin for to open the skin selection interface.
- **Music Note:** This item is invisible when held. Right-click the Music Note to upload .ogg and .mp3 files. Click play to play the audio centered on yourself. After selecting the audio, Shift + Right-click on a block to attach the Music Note to it. When the block with the attached Music Note receives a redstone signal, it will play the audio until the redstone signal ends. Shift + Right-click an attached block while holding the Music Note to remove the attachment.
- **Fortifier:** Right-click two corner points on blocks to fortify them. Fortified blocks cannot be broken in Survival Mode. Shift + Right-click a block to fortify that single block; if it is already fortified, it will unfortify it. Right-click in the air to cancel the selection. When held in Creative Mode, it displays the fortified area.
- **Magic Wand:** Before use, go to `config\projectgm_b\wand_whitelist.txt` and enter the names of players allowed to use the Magic Wand. Right-click the Magic Wand to open the player panel, where you can view and modify player inventories. `/projectgmb wand group <player name> <group name>` allows you to group players for quick preview of their inventory interfaces.
